crossRefs.note: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,

people.name: Zechariah
people.line: Priest, father of John the Baptist

translations.web: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.
translations.bsb: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he took so long in the temple.
translations.kjv: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
translations.asv: And the people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marvelled while he tarried in the temple.
